summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the optimal method for calculating cumulative reach data. Initially, a suggestion was made to modify the data request to return non-aggregated daily unique user counts and location breakdowns, with the summation logic handled client-side or on the backend. Someone noted that the current system (CH) already has a function available for cumulative totals, which is currently used for displaying reach. The participant agreed to write a query today to test its performance and determine if pre-aggregation is necessary or even feasible.
decisions: Test the performance of the existing cumulative total function in CH for reach data.
action_items: [me] will write a query today to test the feasibility and speed of using the built-in cumulative total function.
